case.label: physical source
case.sql: CREATE TABLE fws_src(id INTEGER,p INTEGER,v BIGINT)

case.label: simple final-source-id
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_0'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_0'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id

case.label: simple no-final-order
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_1'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_1'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src

case.label: simple final-other-source
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_2'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_2'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY v

case.label: simple final-window-alias
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_3'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_3'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY a

case.label: simple both-window-aliases
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_4'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_4'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY a,b

case.label: simple final-window-ordinal
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_5'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_5'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY 2

case.label: simple source-order-limit
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_6'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_6'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id LIMIT 2

case.label: simple source-order-offset
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_7'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_7'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 2

case.label: simple source-order-ties
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_8'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_8'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id FETCH FIRST 2 ROWS WITH TIES

case.label: simple wrapped-window-subtree
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_9'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,(lag(nextval('fws_9'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id))+0 AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id

case.label: simple different-offset

case.label: simple separate-named-clauses
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_11'),0) OVER w1 AS a,lag(nextval('fws_11'),0) OVER w2 AS b FROM fws_src WINDOW w1 AS(ORDER BY id),w2 AS(ORDER BY id) ORDER BY id

case.label: simple default-vs-explicit-ASC
case.sql: SELECT id,lag(nextval('fws_12'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag(nextval('fws_12'),0) OVER(ORDER BY id ASC) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id

case.label: simple independent-SQL-child-sites
case.sql: SELECT id,lag((SELECT nextval('fws_13')),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,lag((SELECT nextval('fws_13')),0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id

case.label: simple ordinary-volatile-not-CSE

case.label: simple window-aggregate-FILTER
case.sql: SELECT id,sum(nextval('fws_15')) FILTER(WHERE id%2=0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS a,sum(nextval('fws_15')) FILTER(WHERE id%2=0) OVER(ORDER BY id) AS b FROM fws_src ORDER BY id

case.label: simple DISTINCT-target-boundary

case.label: simple conditional-projection-reference
